form:FormGroup.label: Enabled
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the table builder runs for this rule.

form:FormGroup.label: Processing Node
form:FormGroup.helpText: Node that runs the table builder for this rule; it does not run on any other node.

form:FormGroup.label: Min Stream Create Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Streams created before this time are not processed. Leave blank for no lower limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank for no lower limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Stream Create Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Streams created after this time are not processed, and no results are reported beyond it. Leave blank for no upper limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank for no upper limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Time To Wait For Data
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for late data before rows are reported. Rows are reported up to the latest event time in the table minus this period. Default is 1 Hours.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Wait for late data before reporting. Default is 1 Hours.

form:FormGroup.label: Time To Keep Data In The Table
form:FormGroup.helpText: Data older than this, measured back from the latest event time in the table, is deleted. Default is 1 Hours.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Older data is deleted. Default is 1 Hours.

form:FormGroup.label: Processing Info
form:FormGroup.helpText: Shows the table builder's progress, such as the last run time, streams and events processed and any message. Select Refresh to update it.
